sources.name: AirTrunk news — JHB1 official opening (operations + TNB connection)
sources.license: company website; quoted for research attribution only

exact_passages.quote: AirTrunk has commenced operations in Malaysia, following the official opening of its flagship Malaysian 150 megawatt (MW) hyperscale data centre in Johor Bahru, named AirTrunk JHB1

AirTrunk worked with Malaysian utility company Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB) to connect JHB1. This follows an MOU with TNB signed in 2023 that will see the two companies advance the energy transition in the region.
The initial phases of JHB1 will provide over 50MW of capacity for its large technology customers.
JHB1 is also equipped with a solar ready roof, able to provide over 1MW of power for this phase, making it one of the largest onsite solar deployments for a data centre in Southeast Asia.
The rapid and safe delivery of JHB1 is a pivotal step in the adoption of AI in Malaysia and AirTrunk’s growth as a trusted partner for our customers in the APJ region.

control_or_dependency.known: CORRECTED 2026-10-31: the primary document (Blackstone release, 4 Sep 2024) records a DEFINITIVE AGREEMENT (buyer funds + CPP Investments named; subject to FIRB approval) — an agreement, not a closing. Completion is secondary (deal tracker, 'closed'). control_or_dependency.counterparty_concentration: the same corporate group (AirTrunk) sits on both sides of the JHB1 (facility) and VPPA (offtake) relationships — group-internal linkage, not evidence of third-party dependency

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The ib vogt VPPA supplies JHB1 with electricity (direct physical supply).
falsification_attempts.attempts: SUPERSEDED CHECK 2026-10-31: after the supervisor-supplied sources, re-examined the FY24 Sustainability Report ('to support JHB1’s energy consumption' / 'for our JHB1 campus'), the opening release (TNB connection), and the VPPA announcements for any statement of a physical supply path from the solar farm to JHB1.
falsification_attempts.result: STILL NOT ESTABLISHED AS PHYSICAL SUPPLY: the company documents support a procurement-to-consumption link (financial VPPA 'supporting' JHB1’s consumption) and a TNB grid connection; neither states that the solar farm physically powers JHB1. The strong 'powers JHB1' claim remains unproven.
falsification_attempts.verdict: PARTIALLY SUPERSEDED: the earlier 'no accessible passage connects them' finding is superseded (the FY24 report names the link as consumption-support); the physical-supply conclusion is UNCHANGED and still unproven.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The US$2.3B green loan finances JHB1.

falsification_attempts.result: FALSIFIED by the source's own wording: the loan funds 'its JHB2 hyperscale facility' — a different building at the same campus company. JHB1 attribution would contradict the cited passage.
falsification_attempts.verdict: FALSIFIED (as stated); campus-grain financing must not be attributed to JHB1.

falsification_attempts.verdict: NOT ESTABLISHED — unknown; ownership and control are distinct and only the former is (reportedly) documented.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The 30-lender syndicate holds influence over the VPPA or JHB1 operations.
falsification_attempts.attempts: Looked for security packages, covenants or lender roles beyond arrangement (ICD Nova names coordinators for JHB2 only).
falsification_attempts.result: Nothing accessible links lenders to operational or energy decisions.
falsification_attempts.verdict: NOT ESTABLISHED — financing does not imply control; recorded as unknown.
